# Dedsec Terminal

> Personal portfolio of Swaraj Singh, specializing in SOC, GRC, and Security Research.

Dedsec Terminal is the canonical cybersecurity portfolio of Swaraj Singh. The site contains selected projects, security writeups, professional background, research notes, and personal writing.
